definitions.explanation: The official residence or offices of an ambassador.

examples.japanese: {大使館|たいしかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}した→電話する：01471_denwa⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{大使館|たいしかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: I went to the embassy to get a visa.

notes:
{大使館|たいしかん} is an embassy, the official diplomatic mission of one country in another.

WRITING:
⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧ (ambassador) + ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (building) - the ambassador's building.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜{大使館|たいしかん}: ~ embassy (e.g., ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{大使館|たいしかん})
- {大使館|たいしかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the embassy
- ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply for a visa

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧: ambassador
- ⟦{領事館|りょうじかん}→領事館：14757_ryoujikan⟧: consulate (handles visas, citizen services in regional cities)
- ⟦{外交官|がいこうかん}→外交官：14758_gaikoukan⟧: diplomat

USAGE:
Embassies are located in capital cities. For visa services in other cities, look for a ⟦{領事館|りょうじかん}→領事館：14757_ryoujikan⟧ (consulate).
